huytieu-cog-second-brain-braindump.description: Quick capture of raw thoughts with intelligent domain classification and competitive intelligence extraction

huytieu-cog-second-brain-closed-loop.description: Run one task through the V-model verification loop: CP-2 plan → CP-3 build → CP-3v component verify → CP-4 integration verify (full lane) → CP-5 acceptance. The worker never grades its own homework; evidence rows trace back to AC-n. Opt-in: invoke with /closed-loop or by asking for the closed loop, proper verification, or an evidence trail. Ordinary work does not run this.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-comprehensive-a.description: Deep-dive 7-day analysis across all data sources for weekly reviews, board prep, and strategic planning

huytieu-cog-second-brain-content-factory.description: Autonomous content pipeline - scout announcements in your field, triage by trend momentum and personal angle, produce posts/blogs/videos in your voice with ledger-based dedup, hard volume caps, and screenshot-verified publishing

huytieu-cog-second-brain-create-user-sto.description: Create user stories with duplicate checking across any project tracker (Linear, GitHub Issues, Jira)

huytieu-cog-second-brain-daily-brief.description: Generate personalized news intelligence with verified sources (7-day freshness requirement)

huytieu-cog-second-brain-daily-journal.description: A passive daily work journal that Claude keeps FOR you so you never have to write it yourself. Append short entries after meaningful work (what was done, what you focused on, artifacts touched) to 01-daily/journal/YYYY-MM-DD.md. Run a guided reflection at night or in the morning. Use when you run /daily-journal, say "log this to my journal", "add to today's journal", "reflect on today/yesterday", or when finishing a meaningful chunk of work in any session.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-data-forms.description: Pick the right way to represent a dataset so a reader gets the finding in three seconds — a catalog of 20+ chart and diagram forms with when-to-use and failure modes, plus the encoding decisions that make any of them readable (takeaway headline, direct labels, kill the axis, highlight-and-mute, show the caveat). Style-agnostic — use with whatever palette or design system the destination already has. Use when charting survey results, benchmark data, usage metrics, or research findings for a post, brief, deck, or report, and whenever the default bar chart feels like it's burying the point.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-editorial-illus.description: Generate meaning-carrying editorial data-illustrations in the monotykamary / Linear aesthetic (near-black grayscale, Inter display + mono labels, hairline framed figures) with a single coral accent. This is a GENERATIVE GUIDE, not a template gallery: it teaches the "claim -> geometry" method so any session can invent the RIGHT figure for what a post actually argues, then render it as a self-contained, theme-aware, reduced-motion-safe HTML/SVG figure. Use when writing/illustrating a blog post, essay, spec, or slide and you want a chart, diagram, or illustration that carries a thesis (not…

huytieu-cog-second-brain-export-open-iss.description: Audit and export open issues from any project tracker with summary analysis and vault archival

huytieu-cog-second-brain-feature-doc.description: Closed-loop feature documentation for your product. Give it a feature (issue numbers or an id) and it reads the source, drives your live app to capture real screenshots and a screen recording, writes a docs article (Docusaurus or any markdown docs site) with both how-to steps and use-case content, then verifies the article with a fresh-context read-only verifier before reporting. Use when you say "write the doc for <feature>", "document issue #123", or "/feature-doc".

huytieu-cog-second-brain-agents-feature-.description: Document a shipped feature from the live app: real screenshots and a screen recording, a docs article with how-to and use cases, verified before publish

huytieu-cog-second-brain-generate-prd.description: Generate product requirements documents with optional publishing to Confluence or other wiki platforms

huytieu-cog-second-brain-generate-releas.description: Generate categorized release notes from any source (GitHub, Linear, Jira, or manual input) with optional publishing

huytieu-cog-second-brain-harvest.description: Capture durable session learnings, stage for human promotion to 05-knowledge/lizard, and propose skill/CLAUDE.md patches. Triggered by /harvest, SessionEnd hook staging, or nightly enhance. Never writes durable knowledge without your approval.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-knowledge-conso.description: Build frameworks from scattered insights across all braindumps and notes

huytieu-cog-second-brain-loop-engineerin.description: Shared loop-engineering reference for COG skills - the agent loop, deterministic verifiers, termination conditions, in-loop context management, and named patterns. Invoke when designing or debugging a skill that iterates (search-verify-retry, scan-until-dry, fetch-retry-gate).

huytieu-cog-second-brain-meeting-transcr.description: Process meeting recordings and notes into structured decisions, action items, and team dynamics with intelligent noise filtering

huytieu-cog-second-brain-memory-hygiene.description: Periodic trust sweep of persistent memory and durable knowledge notes - re-verifies environment-dependent claims against the live environment, stamps last_verified + confidence, and proposes archiving drifted entries

huytieu-cog-second-brain-museum-art.description: Source authentic, high-res PUBLIC-DOMAIN artwork from museum open-access APIs (Met, Cleveland, SMK, Rijksmuseum, NGA, Art Institute of Chicago, Getty, Smithsonian) instead of AI-generated or generic-stock imagery. The default move whenever a visual needs an aesthetic, credible image (blog heroes, decks, social cards, essay/spec figures). Verified keyless recipes + licensing rules inside.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-no-ai-slop.description: Edit drafts into sharper, more human writing while preserving the writer's personal voice, or detect AI-slop patterns without rewriting. Use when the user wants a draft clearer, more direct, more opinionated, or less AI-sounding, or asks whether writing reads as AI. Also the default writing standard for all agent output: 80% ASD-STE100 controlled language plus the format ladder (prose, diagram, HTML page, explainer video).

huytieu-cog-second-brain-onboarding.description: Personalize COG for your workflow - creates profile, interests, and watchlist files with guided setup (run this first!)

huytieu-cog-second-brain-product-ui-tast.description: Anti-slop skill for PRODUCT UI - dashboards, data tables, forms, multi-step flows, settings, list/detail, app shells. The agent reads the surface, budgets the frame first, and ships dense interfaces that are correct at every edge case (overflow, long labels, empty/error/loading states, i18n expansion, keyboard/a11y). House-system-first; maps to Carbon/Polaris/Atlaskit/Fluent/Primer/Material3/Radix-shadcn/Ant. The counterpart to taste-skill, which owns landing/portfolio/marketing.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-publish-to-conf.description: Publish any markdown file from the vault to Confluence with format conversion and approval gate

huytieu-cog-second-brain-release-comms.description: Release communication pipeline for your product: turn a deployment runsheet and a GitHub milestone into a customer-facing release note with real screenshots and videos, docs updates (including retrofits of articles the release makes stale), a Slack announcement draft, and a lightweight marketing package. Use when you say "cover today's release", "write the release note", or "/release-comms".

huytieu-cog-second-brain-agents-release-.description: Turn a deployment runsheet and a GitHub milestone into a customer release note with real media, docs updates, and a Slack announcement draft

huytieu-cog-second-brain-release-video.description: Turn a product release (the list of shipped items plus real screen recordings) into a motion recap video and one explained demo per feature, with sound effects tied to on-screen motion and a composed music bed. Deterministic HTML scenes rendered frame by frame, ElevenLabs for sound effects and music, ffmpeg for the mix. Use when asked for a release video, a changelog video, a feature recap reel, or demo clips for release notes and docs.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-retro.description: CP-7 retrospective: audit checkpoints, evidence quality, action items, and harvest candidates. Closes the V-model cycle and feeds the next run. Use via /retro after ship, escalate, or significant session.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-review-cockpit.description: Produce and continuously maintain ONE living review document for a multi-item session — a cockpit header (Progress checklist, Working folder, Context) plus per-item review cards that you approve or request changes on directly in the doc or side panel. Use whenever a session has multiple deliverables you need to review/approve (meeting-processing + planning, multi-ticket work, briefs with several drafts, any "do X, then plan/draft Y and Z"). The doc is the interaction surface: you edit it (or reply in chat) to approve/change; the agent keeps it live as work progresses.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-scout.description: Evaluate URLs and tools — check vault coverage, assess relevance, recommend save or skip

huytieu-cog-second-brain-slop-gate.description: Deterministic pre-publish scan that refuses AI-slop tells in anything about to be written, published, or sent: files, artifacts, slide titles, table headers, diagram labels, chat messages, commit messages. Use before publishing or sending any deliverable, in CI, or wired as a Claude Code hook so the check runs without being remembered. The editorial counterpart is no-ai-slop, which rewrites; this one blocks.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-social-media-ki.description: Produce and attach native media (video teaser, GIF, card images) for every social post to maximize reach and interaction. Use whenever you post to X, LinkedIn, Reddit, or prepare HN/IndieHackers handoffs, and whenever a social-publishing step runs. A text-only social post is a draft, not a post.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-agents-social-m.description: Attach native media (teaser video, GIF, card images) to every social post, with per-platform upload steps

huytieu-cog-second-brain-taste-skill.description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. huytieu-cog-second-brain-team-brief.description: Generate daily team intelligence brief by cross-referencing GitHub, Linear, Slack, PostHog, meetings, and braindumps with two-way Linear sync-back

Capture your actual theme, font, prompt and statusline first, and never invent a generic "hacker terminal" look.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-agents-terminal.description: Reproduce your real terminal and CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) faithfully in graphics and video frames

huytieu-cog-second-brain-ultragoal.description: Run a large, multi-session goal (e.g. shipping a whole side product) through the full V-model closed loop, one phase at a time, with cross-session state and a final north-star acceptance gate. Ultragoals never downgrade the lane: every phase runs CP-1→CP-6 with adversarial verification. Opt-in: invoke with /ultragoal or by calling something a long-running goal. Ordinary work does not run this.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-update-cog.description: Check for and apply upstream COG framework updates (skills, docs, scripts) without touching personal content

huytieu-cog-second-brain-update-knowledg.description: Maintain and update product knowledge base from releases, features, and project changes with optional wiki sync

huytieu-cog-second-brain-url-dump.description: Quick capture URLs with automatic content extraction, insights, and categorization into knowledge booklets

huytieu-cog-second-brain-vector-cover.description: Generate flat vector editorial cover illustrations in a warm editorial style: near-black canvas, cream organic blob, serif display type, one terracotta accent, and thin line-art concept motifs (grids, node charts, dashed "unknown" paths, mountains, question marks). Output is code (HTML + inline SVG) rendered to a crisp 2400x960 PNG via headless Chrome. Use when you want a blog, article or X-article cover image, a "hero graphic", or "make a cover for <title>".

huytieu-cog-second-brain-agents-vector-c.description: Flat vector editorial cover illustrations in HTML and SVG, rendered to a 2400x960 PNG with headless Chrome

huytieu-cog-second-brain-voice-baseline.description: Measure your own writing corpus for the words and sentence shapes you over-use, so an agent writing in your voice stops amplifying your tics into a style. Produces a counted baseline file and checks any new draft against it. Use when an agent's drafts start sounding like a caricature of you, before publishing anything written in your voice, or every ten new pieces to re-measure.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-weekly-checkin.description: Cross-domain pattern analysis and strategic reflection for weekly review

huytieu-cog-second-brain-youtube-video-k.description: Produce YouTube-ready video packaging: a branded thumbnail, an animated opening title, background music via ElevenLabs Music, and the upload metadata bundle. Use whenever you make or publish a video (deep dives, demos, blog companions) or want thumbnails, intros, video music, or channel and playlist consistency.

huytieu-cog-second-brain-agents-youtube-.description: YouTube packaging: thumbnail, animated opening title, ElevenLabs music bed, and the upload metadata bundle
